title: feat(components)!: action values ride properties.params; params is only the input list (#10289)
body:
Fixes #10289
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

This implements ruling A on the card (comment `5825589480`, maintainer 「批 #224 同意」): an action's `params` is only the `ActionParam[]` inputs list. A node's static execution values ride `properties.params`.

- `action:button` and `action:icon` read static values only from the node's `properties.params`. They forward those values to the runner as `ActionDef.params`, which is where `navigate_create` / `navigate_edit` read `objectName` / `recordId`.
- A node-level `params` **object** is not read. It is ignored, and a development build logs one warning per action (`[action:button] action "X" carries an OBJECT under node-level params; it is ignored ...`). The warning names `properties.params`, and `bodyExtra` for an api payload. It is silent in production. The precedent is the dev-only, warn-once `console.warn` that `auto-trigger.ts` and core `actionKeys.ts` use.
- A node-level `params` **array** still works as the input list and is forwarded as `actionParams`. `action:icon` used to forward any `params` raw; it now routes through the same `paramsPayload` as `action:button`. The runner already treated an array `params` as `actionParams`, so the input path behaves as before.
- The two channels are independent. An `action:bar` member, which is mounted without `SchemaRenderer`, can carry inputs in `params` and values in `properties.params`, and both are forwarded.
- The renderer reads `schema.properties.params` itself instead of the hoisted `schema.params`. `SchemaRenderer` copies `properties.params` onto the node, and `action:bar` members skip that hoist. An identity check tells a hoisted copy apart from a node-level object. The helper is `packages/components/src/renderers/action/static-params.ts`.

Docs: `content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md` and the `@object-ui/app-shell` README now teach `properties.params` in both examples. They say that a node-level `params` object is ignored, and how to migrate. The README also had a stale claim that templates inside `params` are not evaluated, which objectui#10282 had already made false. That claim is replaced.

## Census (taken on the base `0348bc9f1`, before the change)

Instrument: a one-off scanner run over every tracked file (CHANGELOGs excluded). It walks every JSON document for a `params` key holding a plain object, and it matches `params` followed by an object literal in ts/tsx/js/mjs/md/mdx/yaml text. Each text hit was then classified by hand. Nothing re-derives this reading; it is a historical measurement, not a live count.

**Authors of a node-level `params` object on an `action:button` / `action:icon` node: 13.**

| where | sites | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md` | 2 | migrated |
| `packages/app-shell/README.md` | 2 | migrated |
| app-shell `AppContent.tsx`, the `navigate_*` handler comment | 2 | migrated |
| `action-bodyShape-forward.test.tsx` (`action:button`) | 3 | migrated |
| `action-forward-precedence.test.tsx` (the shared fixture) | 1 | migrated |
| `action-params-templates-7867.test.tsx` | 3 | 2 migrated; CASE A flipped to pin the object form as not read |

- JSON metadata under `examples/`, `apps/` and `schema-catalog`: **0**. The JSON walk found no `params` object anywhere.
- Published `skills/`: **0**. Its one action `params` is the `ActionParam[]` form, in `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`. No governed file is touched.
- Stored metadata outside this repo (`sys_metadata` rows): **NOT MEASURED**, because this repo cannot read it.
- `.changeset/7867-action-params-templates.md` (pending) shows one node-level example. It is another card's changeset and was not edited. The new changeset says that the form is no longer read.
- The other text hits are the runner's own `ActionDef.params` (the values channel that handlers and hosts build in code), query params, nav-item params, i18n label params and similar. None of them is an authored action node.

## Readers, and a premise correction

- The **authored-node readers** of the object form were the `paramsPayload` non-array branch in `action:button`, and `action:icon`'s raw `params` forward. Both are moved.
- app-shell `recordFormNavigation.ts` (`action.params?.recordId` / `objectName`) and `useObjectActions.ts` read the **runner's** `ActionDef.params`. They do not read the authored node. Core declares that key as the values map (`params?: Record string-to-any`), and `action:button` now fills it from `properties.params`. They cannot read `properties.params` themselves, because the handler receives an `ActionDef`, which has no `properties`. So they keep their reads. Only their docs changed: the `NavigationActionDef` docblock and the `AppContent` comment now describe the channel and teach `properties.params`. The card's list of these two files as object-form readers was half right: the keys they read are the right ones, but on the runner layer.

## Boundary: surfaces left unchanged here

These also forward a non-array `params` as values, but they are spec **action** entries, not SDUI nodes. They have no `properties` bag, and another ruling governs them:

- `element:button`'s inline `action`;
- `action:group` / `action:menu` items;
- `page:header`'s `dispatchHeaderAction`.

For a `type: 'api'` action, the objectstack#5777 ruling keeps the runner reading an object `params` as the payload for one version window, with a dev warning, removed at 18. Spec already refuses the object form at the authoring door, and the ADR-0087 conversion rewrites it to `bodyExtra`. Retiring these surfaces now would pre-empt that window, so they are listed rather than changed.

## Tests

New pin file `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-params-properties-10289.test.tsx` (21 tests). It covers `action:button` and `action:icon`, each on both mounts (direct registry mount and through `SchemaRenderer`), and pins the following:

- values come from `properties.params`;
- a node-level object is not read as values, and the warning fires once and names `properties.params`;
- `properties.params` wins over a node-level object;
- the `ActionParam[]` path still arrives as `actionParams`;
- both channels together;
- the warning is once per action, not per click, and silent in production.

Union at `c3aff649a` (final HEAD), all run from the repo root:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, the bodyShape / bodyExtra / element:button 8071 / page-header-actions suites, app-shell `recordFormNavigation.test.ts`, and `scripts/__tests__/` for doc-expression-carriage and both action-forward-parity suites: **32 files, 548 tests passed**.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the tests): green at `c3aff649a`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check`: green at `5f7cb6fc5`. Only comments and docs changed in app-shell after that.

## Ablation

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor was proven to land (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), and the restore was proven on disk (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). These tests import the renderers by relative path, so the mutated source is what runs. The direction was predicted before each run.

1. `action:button` values read reverted to the old `params: schema.params`: **10 red**. That is button direct-mount properties, both not-read pins, direct-mount wins, the production pin, the 3 bodyShape wire pins, 7867 CASE A, and precedence's carried values. The SchemaRenderer-mount "reads from properties.params" pin stays green, as predicted, because the hoist puts the same object on `schema.params`.
2. `action:icon` back to a raw `params` forward: **8 red**. That is the icon properties, not-read (both mounts), wins, input list (both mounts), both-channels, and the precedence carried-values pins.
3. The dev warning deleted: **5 red**. That is the four once-warning pins and the per-action memo pin.

## Gates run locally

- Green: `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:action-ref-convention`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-expression-carriage` (report-only).
- ESLint on the 9 changed ts/tsx files: 0 errors. The warnings are the files' existing `no-explicit-any` / react-refresh warnings.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 12 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, because it needs every package's `dist/*.d.ts` and the README edit adds no import. Also NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins`, because it needs a console build and no registration changed. Both are left to CI.
- `packages/types` was not touched, so the Spec Main Shape Gate type-check does not apply.

## Acceptance notes

- `SchemaRenderer` still evaluates a node-level `params` bag (carrier 1 of objectui#10282). No in-tree renderer reads that value any more, so the evaluation is dead work, and the unevaluated-expression diagnostic can still name a leaf inside it. `@object-ui/react` was left unchanged to keep this PR to the renderers the ruling names. A follow-up can drop carrier 1 there.
- Under `SchemaRenderer`, the `properties` hoist copies `properties.params` over a node-level `params`. So one node cannot carry both an input list (node-level) and values (`properties.params`) on that path; the values win. Nothing in the repo authors both, and base behaved the same way. Directly mounted `action:bar` members get both.
- The guide now says the diagnostic reports an unresolvable template under `properties.params.recordId`. The 7867 pin now asserts that exact path.
- #10282's changeset (pending) shows the node-level form; see the census.
